Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
If I Clan Impersonate a Ravnos to another clan the turn before the
last counter would be removed from the mastercard, my CI'd vamp would
be able to ignore the counters on him, right? Do they go away when the
last counter is removed from the mastercard as well, or does my vamp
have to burn blood for the counters if he burns the CI?

I also wonder about another thing. Previously the designers had a
policy to not change wallpapercards and make them better if there
wasn't something with them to be errata'd as well. With FN it clearly
seems like they've changed this policy and upgraded cards like Ravnos
Cache, Powerbase: Rome etc. Does this mean a change of the policy, and
how come it was so defended just a few months ago and now suddenly
abandoned (apparently)?
